_comment: C0-16 正文英译 · andi（2026-10-25）。无附加小节。正文「相关条目」3 行带 .md 链接（kagi/perplexity/metaso），related 写 3 条（frontmatter related 是 [kagi, perplexity, metaso, chatgpt]，键按正文链接行对齐=3）。sources 4 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 照源短译（含三条实测建议段）。

axes.model_access: Self-developed retrieval+generation architecture (official narrative: generating answers directly rather than "retrieve then wrap" — the "direct answer" route); an in-house model line (official narrative), no routing to third-party LLMs (official framing, not verified item by item).
axes.runtime: Web (andisearch.com) as the main entry; retrieval and generation both happen on the vendor's cloud; no officially stated local/offline form seen.
axes.local_files: Privacy narrative: no tracking, no profiles stored (the official privacy page's narrative); no other local data surfaces officially stated seen.
axes.background: Search Q&A returns instantly; no official task queue or "keep-running-after-shutdown" style background task surface seen (not verified item by item).
axes.tools: AI-native search (answers generated directly + source attribution), a follow-up-dialogue line, and an **"explain it like a friend" plain-language answer style** (official narrative); no ads (product posture).
axes.context: Follow-up questions work within the same session; cross-session memory and personalization profiles not verified to an official statement (the privacy narrative instead stresses not storing profiles).
axes.permissions: Free product (D9: pricing not collected); the terms-level landing of the privacy promises (no-tracking narrative) not verified item by item; the training-use switch not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: lightweight research wanting direct answers with an explanation style, tracking-sensitive users, free-and-ad-free needs. Does not fit: deep academic retrieval (no academic vertical), Chinese-first usage, wanting an auditable retrieval process.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creation products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **Answer-quality comparison of "direct answer" vs Perplexity's "retrieval + citation"** (same question set)
- **Coverage of source attribution** (how many answers carry verifiable citations)
- **Actual verification of the no-tracking narrative** (network-request observation)
unknowns:
- Technical details of the self-developed architecture (official narrative, not verified item by item)
- Product longevity/funding status (no official statement verified — risk item)
- The training-use switch (not verified item by item)
- Chinese-query quality (not measured)
related: Also privacy-oriented search: Kagi self-builds its index on a subscription model, Andi self-builds its answer architecture for free.
Route contrast: Perplexity aggregates retrieval + citations, Andi generates answers directly.
Chinese counterpart: Metaso goes deep in Chinese, Andi is English-leaning and lightweight.
